answers.rationale: This requirement pertains to the experience and capabilities of the technology partner in terms of installation, commissioning, and integration of systems. It does not directly specify a product from the catalog, so it is not mapped to any product.

This requirement is about compliance with ISO 9001:2015 certification, which is a general qualification requirement for the technology partner. It does not relate to a specific product from the catalog.

The requirement for software/hardware upgrades and design optimization aligns with the EMS-DESIGN service, which covers user-centred design and engineering, including hardware and software design, to meet customer requirements and standards.
